derived_observations: This is the first observed Amateur Title Fight in the controlled career, appearing while Jacob is still UNRANKED at 9-0-0 with 8 KOs. One observation is not enough to infer the exact title-fight trigger threshold.
The title contract materially changes the amateur fight format from previously observed ordinary/rival four-round bouts to six two-minute rounds and explicitly awards the Amateur Belt.

The correlated contract block contains total purse 22000 and player split 25 while the UI renders a $5,500 player cut. No independent 5500 value was identified in the same block, strongly suggesting that the displayed player cut is derived from total purse and split rather than stored independently.
Jacob remains UNRANKED at the first observed amateur title opportunity, showing that a numeric professional-style rank is not required for this observed amateur title-fight state.
next_capture: Preserve checkpoint 13 as the pre-title baseline.
Fight Nathan Ferguson and win naturally; there is no reverse-engineering need to force a decision or a loss.
Capture the result/payout screen and any Amateur Champion, belt, newspaper, or Amateur-to-Pro transition messaging.

Take one new savestate at the next stable post-fight Career Central/progression state before training or signing another contract. Only take an extra state if a unique modal transition exposes a distinct state that disappears after one input.
